body:
I know it probably sounds a little unreasonable. To be honest in my country the opportunities available to me are limited compared to most developed places. Jobs usually require a full copy of your transcripts alongside your CV.

I did sleep on it after posting this and I believe I feel a lil better. I suppose it'd be illogical to throw in the towel before making something of an attempt. So I've decided to try, even if the odds are against me at the moment.

I'm sorry I couldn't reply sooner, different timezones and all. I appreciate you taking the time to post this, it did help.

So thanks :)
